summary: RPCS3 Core 909 = Core 908 plus the God of War III levers (build 694 device logs, Core 907, BCES00510 app 01.00). (1) REWINDBOX_SCOPED_RSX_UPLOADS_909: NV308A inline data and NV0039 copies (the RSX methods that write one exact range of guest memory; NV3089 CPU blits keep the epoch) revalidate only the texture sections over the written range (Core 573 path) when the scope is on (Automatic: God of War III) instead of starting a new texture epoch that re-hashes every texture (about 358 epochs per frame and 15.96 GB hashed per 5 s window on build 694). (2) REWINDBOX_EPOCH_SOURCES_909: epoch advances counted per source (COREPROF EPOCH909). (3) REWINDBOX_GOW3_MLAA_REPORT_909: what the MLAA bypass applied (COREPROF GOW3MLAA909; the 01.00 executable is outside the PPU half). (4) REWINDBOX_FREEZE_LABELS_909: the label lines around a stalled RSX acquire in the freeze dump. ABI 30, the 92 exports and the PPU/SPU codegen identities unchanged. Not built, no iPhone run.
